bio:
Child of Stephen and Julia Ann Scott of Kingston (FamilySearch; probable). 21 in 1850.

FamilySearch gives Henry a death date of 7 Apr 1895 and a wife, Margaret Ann Davis (1834-1884), with children from 1853. A New York county marriage record of a son, Walter S. Scott, names Henry as his father ([R4-S1]). FamilySearch dates Stephen J. Scott's death to 19 Apr 1856 at Kingston.
sources: [R4-S1] FamilySearch published tree, Henry Scott (GM97-D3R), with attached index entries (derivative) https://www.familysearch.org/service/tree/tree-data/published/persons/GM97-D3R
